svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Two traces from a full-wave rectified 17 volt peak supply. Without a capacitor the voltage is a row of humps falling to zero 120 times a second. With 2,200 microfarads across a 100 ohm load, the capacitor charges at each peak and sags only about 0.6 volts between them.
svg.text: A capacitor fills on each peak and feeds the load in between
time: three cycles of 60 Hz mains (50 ms)
with 2,200 µF across 100 Ω: ripple ≈ 0.6 V
